question: Why is shining-forth fitting in the form of emanation?
premises: but of waking state and others
each manifold division will be determined
therefore fitting shining-forth in form of emanation
inference: Because each state's manifold division will be determined, shining-forth in emanation form is fitting.
plain_english: But the manifold division of waking state and others will be determined for each; therefore shining-forth in the form of emanation is fitting.
